title: It's an okay product
text: It's an okay product. I bought these so save space in a cedar chest filled with bed sheets. The first one had a hole in it and another one didn't hold air like it was supposed to. The ones that did work, worked nicely. I just pulled some sheets out of the one that stayed sealed and they smelled awful so i had to rewash them. I'm not impressed, but not totally disappointed.
